name: audit_discovery_evaluation_v1
purpose: Under a fixed learning procedure, do the full symmetric representation and model identity give a checkable audit increment? Decide whether any scenario merits independent confirmation. All 7 datasets are reported; no positive result is required.
naming: Evaluation inside the original test split is called the 'audit discovery evaluation'.

data_roles.train: fitted the base candidate models (artifact field trained_on)
data_roles.validation: candidate eligibility (validation AUC) and tau (validation prevalence)
data_roles.test: audit discovery evaluation only; the audit head is cross-fitted inside it
data_roles.prior_use: Test splits were sealed on 2026-05-23 (docs/sealed_test_mtimes.md) and afterwards used in descriptive evaluations in v0.4-v1.8 (discovery arm, v1.2 baselines, v1.4 score controls). They are not untouched.
data_roles.untouched_confirmation_data: None available locally for these 7 datasets (all splits used). German/Australian credit were used in v0.7 and are too small; not used here. Independent confirmation would need new data.
data_roles.leakage_check: tau = validation prevalence for all 7; base models trained on train; candidates screened on validation AUC; no test labels used upstream. Cross-fitting the audit head does not address any base-model-level leakage, and none was found in the recorded artifact fields.

units: Rows. IDs are unique; no borrower/subject identifiers are available (recorded as a limitation); rows are treated as independent units. The evaluation is cross-sectional within each test split, not a forecasting split.

candidates.rule: global validation-AUC rule within the cached family-conditioned set (which contains every globally eligible candidate)

reference: p_dep = the deployed M2 voter's predicted probability; yhat = 1[p_dep >= tau]; targets AllErr = 1[yhat != Y], FN = (1 - yhat) Y.
outcome_model: Every representation fits the outcome Y; fitted probabilities are converted to AllErr/FN target risks via the reference decision (src/audit_revision_v1_9.py target_probability), as in the paper.

representations.G1: [logit S, logit C], C = arithmetic mean of global candidates' probabilities
representations.G2: G1 + D, D = max - min of candidate probabilities (raw)
representations.SYM: G2 + logit of sorted candidate probabilities
representations.ID: SYM + logit of candidate probabilities in fixed registry order
representations.GX: G1 + the deployed artifact's raw feature columns (encoder fitted inside each training fold; <=120 levels native categorical, otherwise numeric parse or ordinal; unseen levels missing)
representations.G1add: additive G1 reference: separate cubic splines (5 quantile knots, no bias) + StandardScaler + logistic C=1

redundancy_flags: From 13_discovery_roles.csv. hmda and home_credit: M_global=2 and S is one of the two candidates, so G2, SYM and ID are algebraic functions of G1 (S, C): differences there are fit/representation effects only and cannot reflect new information. M_global=2 in general makes SYM equivalent to G2.

HGB.note: the configuration that passed the identity positive control (script 11); used for G1, G2, SYM, ID, GX; no tuning, seed or metric search

budget.fold_allocation: B_k by largest remainder of B*n_k/N, ties to the lower fold index; fixed before evaluation
budget.queue: inside each held-out fold, top B_k by target-aligned risk (rounded to 1e-12), ties by ascending row ID; hits, targets and budgets summed over folds, then capture = H/T and precision = H/B
budget.remaining_capacity: sum_k min(B_k, T_k) - H_reference: a sample ceiling under the fold quotas, not a learnable-information bound

contrasts.interpretation: ID-G1 > 0 alone does not establish an identity mechanism; ID-SYM > 0 with ID worse than G1 is not a practical audit improvement; a positive ID-SYM is first called 'an increment of the ordered representation under this learning procedure', not proof of added conditional information.

bootstrap.scheme: multinomial row weights drawn within each fold (fold sizes fixed), shared across all methods and targets; fixed OOF predictions; fold-wise B_k queues
bootstrap.intervals: percentile; pointwise 95% for all; Bonferroni over the 14 primary comparisons (alpha 0.05/14)
bootstrap.caveat: Exploratory approximation: does not cover refitting, candidate selection, cross-fitting dependence or prior research exploration. Bonferroni does not repair these limits.

materiality_rule.source: draft protocol of 2026-10-22 (IDEA_UPDATE.md): meaningful gain = dH >= max(5, 0.10 * remaining capacity) and the lower bound > 0 (adjusted for primary, pointwise for secondary)
materiality_rule.status: research screening rule fixed before the run; not a validated business threshold; continuous effects are always reported
materiality_rule.loss: dH <= -max(5, 0.10 * remaining capacity) and upper bound < 0
materiality_rule.exclusion: remaining capacity >= 50 and upper bound < 0.10 * remaining capacity
materiality_rule.replication: a contrast/target counts as replicated if it shows a meaningful gain in >= 3 datasets and a meaningful loss in none

decision_rules: ID-SYM clearly positive AND ID-G1 has a practical gain: keep as an identity-mechanism lead; check against additive G1; choose at most 1-2 scenarios, freeze the method, and move to independent confirmation.
SYM improves but ID-SYM does not: the lead is in the full symmetric representation; do not report it as an identity gain.
Only GX improves: this full-feature procedure found usable gain; do not infer that candidate disagreement carries or can extract it.
Proper loss improves but audit hits do not: report the separation between prediction improvement and current-budget decision value.

No pre-specified scheme shows a clear practical gain: end this round of real-data expansion; the paper's main line is the exact construction, the synthetic realizable gain, and the negative result within the limited empirical scope.
Wide intervals: state that the evidence is insufficient, not that information is zero; do not start another search round automatically.
stopping_rules: After the run: no new learner, metric, budget, threshold, seed or representation. All 7 datasets are reported, including failures and degenerate configurations.
